card.name: Publisher credits and copyright footers
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small words inside publisher credit lines and copyright notices on health pages, such as after Ebix, Inc, All rights, or Healthwise. Also in web addresses of reference links.

modes.label: Company name credits
modes.description: The comma or period right after a company name like Ebix, Inc in a reviewed-by line.
modes.example: Also reviewed by A.D.A.M. Health Solutions, Ebix, Inc<<.,>> Editorial Team: David Zieve, MD

modes.label: Copyright footer words
modes.description: A word inside a copyright or rights statement at the bottom of a page.
modes.example: Copyright © 2012 EBSCO Publishing All rights<< reserved>>. What can we help you find?

modes.label: Source and link text
modes.description: Part of a web address or a source name in a citation line.

card.plain: It fires on the credit and copyright lines at the end of health web pages, such as A.D.A.M. or Healthwise notices.
